UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated shopper profile created and synchronized via Firebase Google Sign-In.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name from Google profile or user update.

role.description: Access role enforced by security rules (never self-escalated).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Server-managed allowlist document identifying store administrators by UID.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when administrative privileges were granted.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile documents containing PII (email) synchronized on Firebase Google Sign-In.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin membership registry used by security rules for RBAC checks.
